title: Agno MVP: Boot + Transcript Context Ingestion

facts.text: `docker compose up -d --build` starts all services cleanly with no errors.
The agno-app service is reachable at http://localhost:8000 and `/docs` returns HTTP 200.
n8n is in compose.yaml and accessible at http://localhost:5678 after boot.
Cloudflare R2 is mounted into agno-app at `/r2` via rclone volume (the §17 blob landing zone).
All API requests enter through `agents["router"]` (mode="route"); a Platform Ops prompt routes to the Platform Ops team, not the Builder team.
The agno-app container does NOT use `--reload` (it breaks the MCP lifespan).
`app/main.py` uses `AgentOS(base_app=fastapi_app)` + `get_app()` — no subpath mount.

SQL migrations (`sql/0001_init_extensions.sql`, `sql/0002_schema.sql`) apply on first `docker compose up`; `agent_run`, `approval_request`, `evidence_hash`, and `transcript_insight` tables exist with `uuidv7()` PKs.
A database connection with `default_transaction_read_only=on` pointed at the `evidence` schema rejects INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
When a native-confirm tool pauses a run, the resulting `approval_request` row has a non-null `run_id` that maps back to the Agno run.

`agents/providers.py` builds a `PlatformContext` object with `source_tools`, `code_tools`, `readonly_db_tools`, `drive_read_tools`, and `drive_write_tools` populated (cloud lists may be empty if Drive/OneDrive MCP servers are not running).
The `DatabaseContextProvider` read sub-agent (readonly_engine → evidence) cannot invoke write tools at the infrastructure level.
LearningMachine is wired with PROPOSE mode for Entity Memory and Learned Knowledge; a proposed learning surfaces a human-confirm step rather than writing automatically.

Embeddings work without a separate OpenAI key: either NVIDIA NIM embeddings are configured (EMBEDDER_IDS in settings.py) OR `example.env` clearly documents that `OPENAI_API_KEY` is required for the default `text-embedding-3-small` embedder.
`knowledge/platform/conversations/` directory exists and is the documented drop zone for hand-selected transcript files.
`scripts/ingest_knowledge.py` calls `knowledge.ainsert(name=, path=, metadata=)` for each accepted file — not a print stub.
`docker exec -it agentos-api python -m agents.ingestion` completes without import errors and reports the number of documents indexed.

An agent (routed through the Builder team → Dev Copilot) answers a question about the evidence platform architecture using content from the ingested transcripts — the answer references specific context from those files, not just generic knowledge.
The platform boots and agents respond when `NVIDIA_API_KEY` is set (NVIDIA NIM); it also works when `OLLAMA_API_KEY` or `OLLAMA_HOST` is set (Ollama Cloud/local) — no hardcoded model default.
`example.env` documents all variables needed to boot: NVIDIA/Ollama keys, DB vars, HITL vars, n8n vars, R2 vars — and notes the embeddings key requirement.
